金色信封與一年後的時空旅行！: A golden envelope and a time travel journey a year later!
今天在OO國小特教學習教室，老師拿出了四個印著金色翅膀的『時空膠囊密封鐵盒』。桌: Today in the special education classroom of OO Elementary School, the teacher brought out four "time capsule sealed tin boxes" printed with golden wings. Beautiful letter paper and colored crayons were laid out on the table. "Children, in this long journey you've taken, you've learned to hide in your shell like a turtle, to chat while throwing and catching a ball, to wipe away your tears when you fall, and to be considerate of your elders and siblings. Today, we are going to complete the most solemn task in the entire universe—to write a letter to 'yourself a year from now, when you're in a new grade!'" The four little heroes held their pens and earnestly wrote their deepest thoughts on the letter paper. Yu drew a dragon with its wings spread wide and wrote: "To Yu a year from now: I hope that by then you will dare to look into the eyes of new friends and smile, and be able to take a deep breath when you encounter something you're afraid of!" Jun wrote: "To Jun in the future: When you're angry, you must insist on counting to ten and be a reasonable hero!" He drew a big red flower: "To He in the future: Even if the words are dancing, I will slowly cut the chocolate. I'm not stupid, I'm great!" Everyone folded the letters filled with love and vows, placed them in the tin box, and clicked the golden combination lock shut. The teacher's eyes reddened, and she led everyone in a deep bow: "Children, in the future, you will be incredibly proud of your courage and perseverance today!"

Just then, a large truck attempting a right turn sped towards them, its massive cab obstructing the driver's view! A traffic guide standing at the intersection blew her whistle: "Hurry! Danger! We need to stand at the edge of the crosswalk and take a big step back, look left and right to make sure the turning vehicles have completely stopped, then raise the little yellow flag high and take steady steps across the zebra crossing!" The teacher gently greeted Yu at the door: "Yu, sweating so much means you ran really hard today, you're a true hero! But after heroic exercise, you need a 'refreshing transformation'!" The teacher led Yu to the sink, showing him how to use a spare cotton towel dampened with warm water to wipe away the sticky sweat from his forehead, neck, and arms, giving him a refreshing wash of his face. He then changed into a clean, dry blue short-sleeved shirt in the changing room. When Yu emerged from his dry clothes, he looked refreshed and smelled faintly of soap. His classmates patted him on the shoulder with smiles: "Yu, you look so handsome and smell so good after changing! Let's go get some rice!"
